Frontend Design Builder specializes in visual direction, design systems, design-to-code, responsive interaction, motion, accessibility and rendered visual fidelity. The existing Veteran runtime and MCP control plane remain available for supported local and Codex surfaces.

Build this feature as a production-quality vertical slice, including polished frontend behavior and rendered QA when applicable.
Audit this product across engineering and UI quality, implement the highest-value fixes, and verify the real runtime result.
